discipline: Refute, do not confirm. The subject is the third member of a lineage whose two predecessors were both dual-REJECTed, and whose entire stated purpose is to land three SHOULD-FIXes: two raised against golden.v1 (a broken quotation and a missing freeze pin) and one raised dually against golden.v2 (false successor provenance in purpose). The review therefore had three centres of gravity. First, the three repairs were executed rather than read: the restored quotation was compared by == against the live v15 object and against the accepted predecessor bind.v1, the IMPLEMENTATION-FREEZE.md pin was hashed from disk and traced into all three places the predecessor findings named, and the purpose sentence was diffed clause-by-clause against both v2 findings' requiredRepair text. Second, because the characteristic failure of a v3 is landing the repairs while introducing new drift elsewhere, the whole document was structurally diffed leaf-by-leaf against golden.v2, so that every changed, added and deleted leaf had to justify itself against a named finding. Third, every remaining assertion was re-derived from disk rather than carried forward on the predecessors' two clean rounds: all 28 recordedInputs digests, all four verbatim D9 quotations, both intentVerbatim strings, the platform ordered-equality, the register status token, and the required-now count. The structural diff is what makes this ACCEPT load-bearing: it is a positive measurement that nothing outside the three repairs moved, not an absence of suspicion.
